WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
nl AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
sw AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM sw ty JOIN sw ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
  WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)),
agg AS (
  SELECT cs.region, d.fiscal_year, sum(n.net_sales) raw_sales,
    sum(CASE WHEN l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN n.net_sales END) lfl_sales
  FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
  LEFT JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id=n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=d.fiscal_week
  WHERE d.fiscal_week<=22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT ty.region, round(ty.raw_sales,2) raw_ty, round(ly.raw_sales,2) raw_ly, round(100*(ty.raw_sales/ly.raw_sales-1),2) raw_gr,
  round(ty.lfl_sales,2) lfl_ty, round(ly.lfl_sales,2) lfl_ly, round(100*(ty.lfl_sales/ly.lfl_sales-1),2) lfl_gr
FROM agg ty JOIN agg ly ON ly.region=ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY lfl_gr DESC

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, d.fiscal_year, count(*) missing_days, min(d.calendar_date), max(d.calendar_date)
FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN dim_date d
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id=st.store_id AND r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900 AND st.store_id<>999 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week<=22 AND d.is_trading_day
  AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2026-10-04' AND (r.store_id IS NULL OR r.net_sales_before_returns IS NULL OR r.net_sales_before_returns<=0)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR d.calendar_date<=st.close_date)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

WITH sl AS (

),

  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key

  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
sw AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
    (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date<=d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date>=d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
  FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl AS (

  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current

SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY ty.lfl_sales/ly.lfl_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region,
